auto_view: The JSE All Share moved -0.3% on the week to 112,388 and the rand weakened 2.7% to R16.92/$. In New York the S&P 500 moved +2.5% and the Nasdaq +2.3%, with the US 10-year at 5.15%. Commodities: gold -4.6%, platinum -3.2%, Brent -2.5%, copper -2.1%.
